title: Gabtoli Inter-District Bus Terminal Modernization
description: Digital surveying, drone survey covering 58.527 acres (0.236 sq km), and comprehensive improvement planning of Gabtoli Bus Terminal, Dhaka. Scope included designing two terminal buildings, expanding and reorganizing bus counters, bus circulation planning, existing and new storm-water drainage design, detailed design drawings, and Bill of Quantities (BOQ).
deliverables: Topographic survey, 3D model outputs, ground and 1st floor architectural plans, ETABS 3D structural model, storm-water drainage design, and BOQ cost estimation.

title: Gulshan-1 Intersection to Progati Sarani Highway & Drain Improvement
location: Gulshan-1 to Progati Sarani, Dhaka (71.64 Acres / 1.019 km)
description: Road infrastructure improvement works under DNCC, including construction of RCC medians, drainage systems, footpaths, passenger sheds, grill fencing, and traffic signs along Gulshan-1 Intersection to Progati Sarani (Gulshan-Badda Link Road). Includes Road No. 130 (Part) and Road No. 134, lake-side palisading system for bank protection and soil erosion control covering 71.64 acres (1.019 km length), and BOQ.
deliverables: Centerline alignment profiles, cross-sections, 3D model of waiting shelters, drain layout plans, lake-side palisading protection details, and BOQ documentation.

title: Mohakhali Inter-District Bus Terminal Modernization
description: Digital surveying, drone survey covering 37.152 acres (0.15 sq km), and comprehensive modernization of Mohakhali Bus Terminal. Scope included expansion and reorganization of AC and Non-AC bus counters, bus circulation plan, drainage improvement, new storm-water lines, detailed design drawings, and BOQ.
deliverables: Topographic survey, AC & Non-AC bus counter floor plans, 3D model outputs, drainage hydraulic profiles, palisading sections, and structural BOQ.

title: Moheshkhali Sanitary Landfill Leachate Treatment Plant (LTP)
client: LGED / JICA / Nippon Koei Bangladesh Ltd. / OSMO Corporation
description: Structural design and preparation of drawings for the LTP (Landfill Treatment Plant) of the sanitary landfill under the Moheshkhali Solid Waste Management (SWM) project funded by JICA, implemented under LGED, and monitored by Nippon Koei Bangladesh Ltd. Serving waste management facilities for the Rohingya community. Included manual structural calculations, maximum bending moment, maximum shear force, and reinforcement requirements.
deliverables: Reinforced concrete design drawings, manual structural calculation sheets, maximum bending moment and shear force assessments, and technical review reports.

title: Pilot Research Project for Irrigation Water Management (WEB-AIS)
location: Manikganj Region (208.37 km² Across 23 Unions & 260 Mouzas)
description: Pilot research project to improve irrigation management and agricultural planning through an integrated geospatial information system covering 208.37 km² across 23 unions and 260 mouzas in Manikganj. Included GNSS/RTK surveying, UAV mapping, photogrammetry, and cadastral digitization documenting 142.02 km² agricultural land, 536.12 km irrigation canals, and 9,834 irrigation pumps.
deliverables: High-resolution orthomosaics, elevation models, land-cover maps, irrigation networks, groundwater pump inventories, TBM & GCP grid distribution, and enterprise Web-GIS database.

title: Installation of Water-Level Gauge Readers in Gangarampur
location: Gangarampur Union, Batiaghata Upazila, Khulna District
description: Installation and adjustment of river water level gauge readers at three monitoring locations in Gangarampur under BADC. Conducted levelling surveys to establish accurate Reduced Levels (RLs), RTK GNSS observations for precise coordinates and elevations, temporary benchmarks (TBM), measured existing water depths, and constructed bamboo support platforms at Jhopjhopia River, Guiyer Canal Opening, and Guiyer Canal Y-section.
deliverables: Geodetic Reduced Levels (RLs), temporary benchmark records, depth measurements, and water level calibration records.

title: Abdulpur Railway Bypass under RCIPF Subproject 2
client: Bangladesh Railway / Oriental Consultants Global (OCG) / ADB
description: Comprehensive topographic and physical feature survey across 40 acres in Lalpur Upazila under ADB Loan No: 6030 BAN for railway alignment planning and engineering design. Integrated UAV photogrammetry, RTK GNSS, and Electronic Total Station (ETS) surveys using 17 Ground Control Points (GCPs) and DJI Matrice 4E UAV.
deliverables: Georeferenced orthomosaics, Digital Surface Model (DSM), Digital Terrain Model (DTM), 20 cm interval contour maps, cross-sections, LULC maps, utility maps, and railway infrastructure maps with centimetre-level vertical accuracy.

title: Bus Route Rationalization & Implementation Plan for Dhaka
location: Dhaka City Corridors (8,686.886 Acres / 35.15 km² / 150.265 km Length)
description: Concept design and implementation plan for bus route rationalization and company-based operation in Dhaka. Activities included Traffic Count Surveys, UAV drone surveys covering 8,686.886 acres (35.15 sq km and 150.265 km length), and Origin–Destination (OD) surveys at major intersections integrating UAV photogrammetry, RTK GNSS, Ground Control Points, and DJI Matrice 4E UAV.
deliverables: Georeferenced orthomosaics, Digital Surface Model (DSM), traffic count analytics, OD passenger survey models, and concept transit routing maps.

title: Sustainable & Integrated Rural Transport (SIRTP/CSmaRT) 800 km Survey
description: 800 km road survey and Temporary Benchmark (TBM) setup using RTK GNSS receivers under the Sustainable and Integrated Rural Transport Improvement Project (SIRTP) and Climate Smart Rural Transport (CSmaRT) project by LGED.
deliverables: 800 km centerline alignments, geodetic TBM coordinate registries, cross-sectional terrain profiles, and rural transport GIS database.

title: BPDB LT & HT Power Distribution Pole Survey (100,000 Poles)
description: Sub-consultancy by CEGIS for BPDB. Collected RTK coordinate data for approximately 100,000 Low Tension (LT) and High Tension (HT) power distribution poles in Phase 1 & 2, alongside 10,000 Ground Control Points (GCP) across 64 districts.
deliverables: Geospatial utility network shapefiles, RTK coordinate registries for 100,000 poles, substation asset GIS database, and 64-district GCP registry.

title: Mouza & Plot Based National Digital Land Zoning Project
description: Ground control point collection, satellite image rectification, and parcel-level cadastral boundary demarcation for the Mouza & Plot Based National Digital Land Zoning Project under the Ministry of Land across Phase 1 & Phase 2 in sub-consultancy with CEGIS.
deliverables: Rectified mouza sheet geodatabase, agricultural and commercial zoning classification maps, and parcel-level spatial layers.

title: 450 km Detail Road Survey using RTK GNSS
description: Ongoing extensive 450 km detail road survey using RTK GNSS receivers for road design, pavement condition assessment, and widening documentation under LGED.
deliverables: Horizontal alignments, cross-sectional elevation data, culvert and drainage structure inventories, and CAD engineering plans.

title: Detail Topographic Survey at GER Shop, Pahartoli under RCIPF
client: Bangladesh Railway / Oriental Consultants Global Co., Ltd. (OCG)
description: Detail topographic survey using RTK and RTK-enabled UAV under RCIPF project at GER shop, Pahartoli, Chattogram by Bangladesh Railway Department in partnership with Oriental Consultants Global Co., Ltd.
deliverables: Sub-centimeter rail alignment coordinates, workshop building footprints, 3D point cloud, and comprehensive yard topography drawings.

title: Improving Urban Governance & Infrastructure (UGIIP), Shibganj Pourashava
description: Topographic, drainage, and municipal infrastructure survey under the Improving Urban Governance & Infrastructure Project (UGIIP) for Shibganj Pourashava by LGED.
deliverables: Town-wide topographic baseline map, municipal road network inventory, drainage master plan contours, and CAD drawings.

title: Chhatak Ropeway Transportation Survey Project
description: Detailed alignment survey, topographic profiling, and structural foundation measurement for the industrial ropeway transit corridor in Chhatak.
deliverables: Corridor centerline profile, pylon foundation coordinates, digital elevation model, and topographic plan.

title: GCP Data Collection for 4 Upazilas in Pirojpur
description: Ground Control Point (GCP) data collection and static GNSS network adjustments across four upazilas in Pirojpur district under UDD.
deliverables: Permanent geodetic monument coordinates, SOB benchmark tie-in documentation, and orthomosaic rectification GCP datasets.

title: TBM Verification & Establishment in BSMR Maritime University Project
client: Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Maritime University / General Survey
description: TBM verification and establishment for the master campus development of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Maritime University.
deliverables: Calibrated TBM elevation certificates, closed-loop optical leveling traverse logs, and geodetic network map.

title: TBM Establishment in Char Kolatoli & Char Jahiruddin for BWDB Bhola
client: Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB) / General Survey
description: Establishment of temporary benchmarks across Char Kolatoli and Char Jahiruddin under BWDB Bhola for river training and embankment works.
deliverables: Coastal benchmark monument coordinates, tidal datum tie-in charts, and riverbank topographic cross-sections.

title: Tejgaon Truck Terminal Project by DNCC
description: Detailed topographic and physical feature survey for the modern reconfiguration of Tejgaon Truck Terminal under DNCC.
deliverables: Total station and RTK GNSS boundary survey, physical feature map, and parking bay layout drawings.

title: ECB–Jahimuddin Detail Road Survey Project
client: 24 Engineering Division, Bangladesh Army / Geo-Static Survey
description: Detail road survey project executed for 24 Engineering Construction Brigade of Bangladesh Army along the ECB–Jahimuddin corridor.
deliverables: Centerline alignment coordinates, longitudinal and cross-sectional level sheets, and as-built roadway CAD drawings.

title: Road Improvement Project for Gangni Pourashava, Meherpur
description: Detailed engineering topographic survey for municipal road widening, pavement rehabilitation, and road-side drainage improvements in Gangni Pourashava by LGED.
deliverables: Road centerline profile, pavement cross-sections, drainage outfall invert levels, and quantities estimation documentation.

title: Road Improvement Project for Meherpur Pourashava
description: Topographic and engineering survey for urban road widening, asphalt overlaying, and drainage infrastructure development for Meherpur Pourashava by LGED.
deliverables: Topographic base maps, road corridor alignment profiles, drain layout plans, and civil drafting outputs.

title: Bathymetry & RTK Survey for Proposed Islampur Bridge on Brahmaputra River
description: Bathymetry and RTK survey for proposed Islampur Bridge on Brahmaputra River, Jamalpur project by LGED.
deliverables: Riverbed depth contours, river cross-sections, flow velocity profiles, and bridge approach embankment topography.

title: GCP Collection for Gopalganj Economic Zone 1 Project
description: Ground Control Point (GCP) collection and geodetic reference survey for the Gopalganj Economic Zone 1 project by BEZA.
deliverables: High-order geodetic control monuments, coordinates in BTM datum, and site boundary control certificates.

title: Bathymetry & RTK Survey for Proposed Khoksha Bridge, Kushtia
description: Bathymetry and RTK survey for the proposed Khoksha Bridge, Kushtia project by LGED.
deliverables: Riverbed digital terrain models, water depth sounding grids, bridge axis cross-sections, and approach road topography.

title: Bathymetry & RTK Survey for Proposed Doara Bazar Bridge, Sunamganj
description: Bathymetry and RTK survey for proposed Doara Bazar Bridge, Sunamganj project by LGED.
deliverables: Underwater elevation contours, river cross-sections at 25m intervals, hydrographic survey reports, and approach alignment plans.

title: Bathymetry & RTK Survey for Proposed Rangabali Bridge, Patuakhali
description: Bathymetry and RTK survey for proposed Rangabali Bridge, Patuakhali project by LGED.
deliverables: Tidal-adjusted bathymetric chart, scour depth analysis data, coastline topographic drawings, and pier positioning coordinates.

title: GCP Collection Using Static Survey Mode in BREB Substations in Dhaka Zone
description: GCP collection using Static Survey mode in different substations of BREB in Dhaka Zone by Bangladesh Rural Electrification Board.
deliverables: Static baseline post-processing reports, sub-centimeter geodetic pillar coordinates, and substation boundary CAD layouts.

title: Bathymetry & RTK Survey for Proposed LGED Bridge (Deep Nagar to Silicon City)
description: Bathymetry and RTK survey for proposed LGED bridge to connect Deep Nagar & Silicon City project by LGED.
deliverables: Canal bed cross-sections, bank topography, hydraulic clearances, and bridge alignment drawings.

title: Survey & Assessment of Newly Accreted Land in Coastal Mangrove Forest
description: Survey and assessment of newly accreted land in coastal mangrove forest areas using RTK-enabled UAV by Bangladesh Forest Department.
deliverables: High-resolution aerial orthomosaics, accretion boundary maps, vegetation canopy indices (NDVI), and forest geodatabase.

title: Survey of Pourashava across Meherpur, Chuadanga, Kushtia, Jhenaidah, Jashore
client: Local Government Engineering Department (LGED) / Pourashava Authorities
description: Continuous topographic, road asset, and urban drainage infrastructure survey across multiple pourashavas in southwestern Bangladesh under LGED.
deliverables: Town base maps, road corridor profiles, drainage master plans, and municipal GIS layers.
